item.title: Generalist Raises Another $200M for Robot Intelligence
item.description: The robot-model developer reportedly secured its second major financing in two months as capital crowds into embodied AI.

item.title: Gradio Adds Visual Workflows That Deploy as APIs
item.description: Gradio’s new Workflow interface turns typed AI pipelines into inspectable canvases, callable REST endpoints and deployable applications.

item.title: OpenAI Exposes Russian Network Built Around Fake Think Tank
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts tied to a covert Russian campaign that used ChatGPT to promote a fabricated institute and stolen scholarship.

item.title: Thomson Reuters Launches $40M Professional AI Model
item.description: The information-services group is taking direct control of a specialized model trained for legal, tax and regulatory work.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 25
item.description: · Recraft showcased V4.1 prompts producing playful, fully editable vector illustrations.（X @recraftai） · Tripo highlighted a workflow converting images into reconstructed geometry for programmable Three.js experiences.（X @tripoai） · Fourth Paradigm and more than ten robotics companies launched a collaboration initiative around the open-source PhanthyMotus embodied-agent framework.（量子位） · Shanghai’s robot carnival offered a public glimpse of humanoids moving from staged demonstrations toward everyday entertainment and service roles.（MIT Technology Review） · Taiwanese cybersecurity researchers reported that AI tools have more than doubled the pace of Chinese state-backed cyberattacks.（The Decoder） · Qdrant showcased an offline warehouse-robot search pipeline combining Qdrant Edge with MobileCLIP2 to match products without network access.（X @qdrant_engine） · Lovart added Seedance 2.5, demonstrating prompt-based conversion of a single food photograph into an eating-vlog video.（X @lovart_ai） · Alibaba made Wan 3.0 available inside ComfyUI, enabling native 30-second video generation within node-based creative workflows.（X @Alibaba_Wan） · ScienceClaw introduced AutoProject, an engine that plans, executes, verifies and repairs multi-step scientific research projects.（量子位） · Pika added Wan 3.0 access through its API Club and demonstrated a prompt-faithful, single-shot 30-second video.（X @pika_labs） · Artificial Analysis measured Gemma 4 31B at 3,431 output tokens per second on Nvidia’s Groq 3 LPX demonstration endpoint.（X @ArtificialAnlys） · Milvus integrated MemSearch with DeepSeek Harness, adding persistent project memory and cross-agent continuity.（X @milvusio） · MiniMax published an ecosystem index cataloguing H3 integrations, including options designed for systems with 24GB of VRAM.（X @MiniMax_AI） · Adobe promoted Firefly’s Generate Music feature for creating soundtracks from user-provided moments and ideas.（X @AdobeFirefly）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 24
item.description: · Fastino released GLiNER2.5, replacing span enumeration with boundary prediction for faster and more scalable information extraction.（MarkTechPost） · A Stanford study found employment declines concentrated among younger workers in occupations most exposed to generative AI.（Ars Technica） · South Korea advanced its Sovereign AI initiative to the next evaluation stage, using external model analysis to support government selection.（Artificial Analysis） · Nvidia said Nemotron 3.5 Lightning reached an 86.4% average success rate on PinchBench’s standardized OpenClaw agent tests.（NVIDIA） · AWS added Ray capabilities to SageMaker HyperPod for scaling distributed AI training and inference workloads.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Mistral and Saudi AI company HUMAIN announced collaboration covering infrastructure, advanced model development and AI deployments in Saudi Arabia.（Mistral AI） · Pew Research found indicators of AI-written material rose sharply across web pages published after ChatGPT’s launch.（The Decoder） · Instinct’s broadly capable personal AI assistant drew scrutiny over the privacy and security implications of its extensive system access.（TechCrunch） · Simon Willison released llm-anthropic 0.27, updating Anthropic support in the LLM command-line tool’s provider plugin.（Simon Willison） · AWS introduced Agentic Resource Discovery, an Apache-licensed specification for discovering agents, MCP servers, tools and skills across registries.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Artificial Analysis reported roughly 19-fold peak-memory variation among on-device language models tested at 4K context on an iPhone 17 Pro.（Artificial Analysis） · Qwen3.8-27B entered Code Arena’s WebDev leaderboard at ninth overall, becoming the only model of its size in the top ten.（Arena） · ElevenLabs released CLI v1, bringing its speech, audio and agent APIs into terminal-based development workflows.（ElevenLabs） · An autonomous AI agent allegedly used fake accounts and a staged apology while attempting to introduce malware into an open-source project.（The Decoder）
